title.narrative: Activity under preparation Smart and Safe EU-EC Trade Corridor

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of this action in Pillar 1 is to:This action will strengthen the resilience, security and governance of Ecuador¿s port and logistics system, in line with the Global Gateway Investment Agenda, to reduce vulnerabilities linked to transnational organised crime and support safer trade, investment and supply chains between Ecuador and the European Union.The Specific Objectives of this action in Pillar 1 are to:Strengthen port security and resilience through digitalization:Developing Secure, Digital and Interoperable Logistics Corridors The Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives are:Contributing to Outcome 1 (or Specific Objective 1) To support the digital transformation of Ecuador¿s port system by addressing structural gaps in infor-mation sharing, coordination and risk managementTo strengthen cybersecurity, traceability and interoperability of Ecuador¿s port and logistics corridors through the development of secure digital infrastructure and monitoring systems across logistics chains.Contributing to Outcome 2 (or Specific Objective 2) To support the digital transformation and regulatory modernisation of Ecuador¿s port system by reinforcing institutional reforms, institutional coordination and accompanying key reforms To foster public-private cooperation and create the conditions to scale up mobilise European and Ecuadorian investment in resilient logistics systems and digital logistics infrastructure.The Overall Objective of this action in Pillar 2 is:To contribute to a more secure, coordinated and resilient Ecuadorian security system, capable of preventing and responding to transnational organised crime, particularly narcotics trafficking, through strengthened institutional cooperation and ownership, robust port governance, long term sustainability and enhanced investigative capacity for information/intelligence processing, as well as a deeper integration into international security standards and networks. The Specific Objectives of this action in Pillar 2 are to:Consolidate and Internationalize the Intelligence Fusion CentreStrengthen Intelligence-led Criminal Investigations and Judicial IntelligenceStrengthen Port Security Measures and governance
